objective: Test whether exact single-residual support-lattice ownership feasibility E1 admits a direct parity-slot interval characterization derived from current support and persistent geometry.

candidate.release: depth above current support in its column
candidate.deadline: depth + total remaining cells outside that column
candidate.allowedSlots: future plies owned by the residual owner
candidate.intervalCriterion: match all required cells injectively to allowed slots inside [release,deadline]
candidate.prefixCriterion: for every time prefix, column-prefix moves forced by required cells whose deadlines have expired must fit in that prefix

relation_to_prior: G/H are late/forced ownership special cases
E1 is the exact support-lattice oracle
anti_circularity: candidate derived before comparing to E1
E1 used only as structural validation oracle
